description: This Dart file defines a ViewModel class for managing user preferences in a Flutter application. It interacts with a PreferencesRepository to load, modify, and reset preferences, and provides state flags and error messages useful for UI updates.

classes.name: PreferencesViewModel
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based ViewModel for managing user preferences, handling loading, saving, toggling specific preferences, resetting to defaults, and error handling.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads preferences from the repository, initializing data and handling errors.

methods.name: _toggle
methods.description: Internal method to toggle a preference given a key and boolean value, updating preferences and handling errors.
